scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid a chilled seafood grocery box being delivered to an empty porch during a weekend family trip.
Emerging Need: An early menu preview is only speculative; later travel, billing, fulfillment, and helper-availability records align around a scheduled perishable shipment.
Decision Context: Observable records establish the delivery window and cutoff, while the saved subscription note supplies the account route and household preference to skip, not reroute or upgrade packaging.
Consequence: Before fulfillment closes, documentation can keep the box from shipping into an unattended interval; after label lock, the spoilage or theft risk remains for delivery day.
